history.sg_progress: The Administration actively monitors the reserve balances of the health insurance plans and the Health and Life Insurance Committee discusses the matter annually during the plan renewals. As a result, for the upcoming 2023/24 plan year, the Committee has recommended and the Controller has approved a premium holiday to ensure the adequacy of the reserve balances. The latest information circular on the renewal of the United Nations Headquarters-administered health insurance programme (ST/IC/2023/11) confirms the Controller’s decision to grant a one-month premium holiday to participants of the United Nations Worldwide Plan and the Cigna United States dental plan.

history.recommendation_text: The Board recommends that the Administration closely monitor the reserve balances of the health insurance plans and take appropriate actions in due course, to ensure the reserve remains within a reasonable range.
history.administration_response: The annual review of premium requirements for the 2024/2025 plan year based on plan performance and reserve balances was concluded with premium updates implemented effective 1 July 2024. Periodic monitoring of reserve balances is a standard and ongoing process. Contract arrangements have been made for actuarial services to, inter alia, review the reserve requirements from an actuarial standpoint to ensure the long- term sustainability of the health insurance plans.
history.board_assessment: Given that a one-month premium holiday on 1 July 2023 may not change the high level of reserves for the three health insurance plans, the Board considers this recommendation to be under implementation.

history.recommendation_text: The Board recommends that the Administration closely monitor the reserve balances of the health insurance plans and take appropriate actions in due course, to ensure the reserve remains within a reasonable range.
history.administration_response: The recommendation was implemented. The annual review of all health insurance plans conducted by the Health and Life Insurance Committee takes into consideration the reserve balance of each plan. When reserves fall below four months of claims or exceed eight months, premium increases are adjusted accordingly.
history.board_assessment: Given that the Administration closely monitors the reserve balances of the health insurance plans against a range of four to eight months of claims through the annual review conducted by the Health and Life Insurance Committee, and adjusts premiums accordingly to keep the reserves within a reasonable range, the Board considers the recommendation to be implemented.
